style.styleTitle: Personalised Christmas House Glass Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Add a special touch to your Christmas tree with this personalised Christmas house glass bauble. Featuring a charming house design, this elegant glass bauble is perfect for creating meaningful festive memories and makes a thoughtful personalised Christmas gift for family, friends or loved ones. Personalise this Christmas decoration with a year and 2 lines of text, with up to 20 characters per line, making it a unique keepsake to treasure year after year. Ideal for hanging on your Christmas tree, displaying around the home or gifting during the festive season, this personalised glass bauble adds a stylish and sentimental finishing touch to your Christmas décor. Please double-check your personalisation, as your text will appear exactly as entered. Material of the bauble is glass and is supplied with ribbon, ready to hang. Dimensions(mm): Height: 80 Width: 100 Depth: 80.
